# Beauty by Kyrin

Beauty by Kyrin is the independent hair stylist business of Kyrin Weidauer in Las Vegas, NV.
Location: Inside Venus Salon, 8665 W Flamingo Rd, Suite 128, Las Vegas, NV 89147.
Phone and text: 702-533-8176.
Availability: By appointment. Contact Kyrin for availability.
Appointments are requests until Kyrin confirms a date and time. Pricing and service scope are discussed directly; no online payment is collected by this website.
